coverage_notes: Exhaustive survey covering customer segments for MetroGraph (noSQL/SQL startups, data engineers, analysts). Swept across MARKET/COMPETITIVE vectors: (1) Market sizing & CAGR data from tier-2 analyst firms (Gartner, Forrester, Coherent, Business Research Insights, Fortune, Mordor, etc.) targeting data engineering, database visualization, data mesh, and adjacent categories; (2) Primary revenue sources and customer bases from company data (Databricks, Snowflake, Neo4j, MongoDB customer bases); (3) Segment pain points and jobs via industry surveys (dbt Labs 2026 State of Analytics Engineering with 363 respondents; Integrate.io data team structure survey; 2026 State of Data Engineering Survey with 1,101 participants; Stack Overflow 2025 Developer Survey); (4) Competitive landscapes via Gartner Magic Quadrant reports, Forrester Wave reports, and G2/Capterra/TrustRadius review aggregates; (5) Funding and venture ecosystem via Tracxn, Crunchbase, PitchBook, and CB Insights (covering 239 NoSQL startups, 78 funded, 56 Series A+); (6) Product/tool alternatives and positioning via hands-on comparisons (Metabase vs Superset, Tableau vs Power BI vs Looker, etc.); (7) Customer hiring demand and skill gaps (80%+ of CDOs hiring for new roles, 75% struggling to fill; data engineer demand up 100% by 2030); (8) HCI/UX research on dashboard design and user behavior; (9) Emerging segments: GraphRAG adoption, low-code RAG platforms, agentic AI data workflows, data observability becoming table-stakes. Deduped across 60+ distinct sources; tiered per rubric. Notable gaps deferred: regulatory/compliance customer personas (separate GDPR/CCPA leaf), vertical industry depth (healthcare, finance sub-segments), and reseller/channel ecosystems.
